notes: Built from the release source with its patches and the OpenGL ES 3 renderer, packaged as libmelondsds_libretro.so. CMake fetches its dependencies at the commits the release names, except melonDS itself, which builds from melonds_source_url with melonds-patches applied (OpenGL ES 3.2 support and an ARM fix for split-polygon texture coordinates). Uses melonDS's built-in BIOS and firmware unless dumps are in the system folder. No BIOS, firmware or ROMs bundled.
